mcv.name: Mean Corpuscular Volume (MCV)
mcv.what_it_measures: MCV measures the average size and volume of your red blood cells (erythrocytes).

low.title: Low MCV (Microcytosis)
low.description: Your red blood cells are smaller than the expected reference range.
low.recommendation: Discuss this result with a healthcare professional, especially if hemoglobin or ferritin is also reduced.

high.title: High MCV (Macrocytosis)
high.description: Your red blood cells are larger than the expected reference range.
high.recommendation: Consult a physician to review B12/folate levels, thyroid function, or recent medications.

normal.title: Normal MCV
normal.description: Your red blood cell size is within the expected physiological reference interval.
possible_associations: Normal red blood cell development and morphology

mch.name: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin (MCH)
mch.what_it_measures: MCH measures the average amount of oxygen-carrying hemoglobin inside a single red blood cell.

low.title: Low MCH (Hypochromia)
low.description: The average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell is lower than the reference interval.
low.recommendation: Consult your clinician to correlate with total hemoglobin and iron studies.

high.title: High MCH (Hyperchromia)
high.description: The average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell is higher than the reference interval.
high.recommendation: Discuss with your physician in conjunction with MCV and vitamin levels.

normal.title: Normal MCH
normal.description: Hemoglobin content per red blood cell is balanced and within normal reference limits.

hemoglobin.name: Hemoglobin (Hb)
hemoglobin.what_it_measures: Hemoglobin is the iron-rich protein in red blood cells that transports oxygen from the lungs to tissues throughout your body.

low.title: Low Hemoglobin (Anemia)
low.description: Circulating hemoglobin is below the provided laboratory reference range.
possible_associations: Nutritional anemia (iron, B12, or folate deficiency)
low.recommendation: Review these findings promptly with a healthcare provider to investigate underlying causes of anemia.

high.title: High Hemoglobin (Polycythemia / Erythrocytosis)
high.description: Hemoglobin concentration is elevated above expected reference limits.
high.recommendation: Discuss hydration status, smoking, or respiratory health with your doctor.

normal.title: Normal Hemoglobin
normal.description: Oxygen-carrying capacity of blood is within healthy physiological limits.
possible_associations: Adequate oxygen transport and red cell production
normal.recommendation: Maintain a balanced diet rich in iron and essential vitamins.

rbc_count.name: Red Blood Cell Count (RBC)
rbc_count.what_it_measures: The total number of oxygen-carrying red blood cells per volume of blood.

low.title: Low RBC Count
low.description: Total red blood cells are reduced below the reference range.
possible_associations: Bone marrow suppression or renal insufficiency
low.recommendation: Correlate with hemoglobin and hematocrit with your physician.

high.title: High RBC Count
high.description: Circulating red blood cell numbers are above the reference range.
high.recommendation: Review hydration status and pulmonary health with a healthcare professional.

normal.title: Normal RBC Count
normal.description: Red blood cell concentration is within normal limits.

pcv.name: Packed Cell Volume / Hematocrit (PCV)
pcv.what_it_measures: The proportion of total blood volume made up of red blood cells.

low.title: Low Hematocrit (PCV)
low.description: The percentage of red blood cells in your blood is below reference limits.
low.recommendation: Correlate with hemoglobin and red blood cell counts with a clinician.

high.title: High Hematocrit (PCV)
high.description: The percentage of red blood cells in your blood is elevated.
high.recommendation: Ensure adequate hydration and discuss with your healthcare provider.

normal.title: Normal Hematocrit
normal.description: Cellular proportion of blood is within optimal parameters.
possible_associations: Balanced blood volume and cell ratio

mchc.name: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration (MCHC)
mchc.what_it_measures: Average concentration of hemoglobin inside a given volume of packed red blood cells.

low.title: Low MCHC
low.description: Hemoglobin concentration inside red cells is reduced.
low.recommendation: Review alongside MCV and iron parameters with a physician.

high.title: High MCHC
high.description: Hemoglobin is densely packed inside red cells.
high.recommendation: Discuss with a healthcare professional to rule out pre-analytical artifacts or membrane disorders.

normal.title: Normal MCHC
normal.description: Red blood cell hemoglobin concentration is normal.

rdw.name: Red Cell Distribution Width (RDW)
rdw.what_it_measures: The amount of variation in size and volume (anisocytosis) among circulating red blood cells.

high.title: Elevated RDW (Anisocytosis)
high.description: Red blood cells exhibit higher-than-normal variation in size.
possible_associations: Early mixed nutritional deficiencies (iron, B12, or folate)
high.recommendation: A clinical provider can evaluate RDW in combination with MCV to differentiate types of anemia.

low.title: Low RDW
low.description: Red blood cells are remarkably uniform in size.
possible_associations: Normal physiological variant (usually of no clinical consequence)
low.recommendation: No clinical concern when other red cell indices are normal.

normal.title: Normal RDW
normal.description: Red blood cells display uniform, standard size distribution.

wbc_count.name: White Blood Cell Count (WBC)
wbc_count.what_it_measures: The total number of immune system defense cells per volume of blood.

low.title: Low WBC Count (Leukopenia)
low.description: White blood cell count is below the expected reference range.
possible_associations: Bone marrow suppression or medication effect
low.recommendation: Consult a doctor, particularly if you have recurring infections, fever, or fatigue.

high.title: High WBC Count (Leukocytosis)
high.description: White blood cell count is elevated above the expected reference range.
high.recommendation: Correlate with symptoms of infection or inflammation with a healthcare professional.

normal.title: Normal WBC Count
normal.description: Total immune cell count is within expected protective parameters.

neutrophils.name: Neutrophils
neutrophils.what_it_measures: The primary white blood cell subgroup responsible for defending against bacterial and acute infections.

low.title: Low Neutrophils (Neutropenia)
low.description: Neutrophil percentage or count is reduced.
low.recommendation: Discuss with a healthcare provider if experiencing frequent or persistent infections.

high.title: High Neutrophils (Neutrophilia)
high.description: Neutrophil levels are higher than reference limits.
high.recommendation: Review alongside your physician for signs of acute infection or inflammation.

normal.title: Normal Neutrophils
normal.description: Neutrophil levels are within normal range.

lymphocytes.name: Lymphocytes
lymphocytes.what_it_measures: Immune cells including T-cells, B-cells, and NK-cells that combat viruses and build adaptive immunity.

low.title: Low Lymphocytes (Lymphopenia)
low.description: Lymphocyte count or percentage is below the reference interval.
low.recommendation: Discuss with your doctor in context with overall WBC count and recent viral exposures.

high.title: High Lymphocytes (Lymphocytosis)
high.description: Lymphocyte count or percentage is elevated.
high.recommendation: Correlate with recent viral symptoms or exposures with a physician.

normal.title: Normal Lymphocytes
normal.description: Lymphocyte balance is healthy.

eosinophils.name: Eosinophils
eosinophils.what_it_measures: Specialized white blood cells involved in allergic responses and defense against parasitic infections.

high.title: High Eosinophils (Eosinophilia)
high.description: Eosinophil count is higher than expected.
high.recommendation: Review history of allergies, rashes, or new medications with your healthcare professional.

low.title: Low Eosinophils
low.description: Eosinophils are at the lower end of the reference range.
low.recommendation: Typically of minimal clinical concern on routine panels.

normal.title: Normal Eosinophils
normal.description: Eosinophil proportion is within standard limits.
possible_associations: Absence of significant active eosinophilic allergy or response

monocytes.name: Monocytes
monocytes.what_it_measures: Large immune cells that migrate into tissues to become macrophages and clear cellular debris and pathogens.

high.title: High Monocytes (Monocytosis)
high.description: Monocyte levels are above the reference range.
possible_associations: Chronic infection or recovery phase of acute infection
high.recommendation: Discuss with a healthcare provider to assess any chronic symptoms or inflammatory markers.

low.title: Low Monocytes (Monocytopenia)
low.description: Monocyte levels are below the reference range.
low.recommendation: Correlate with total WBC and clinical symptoms with your doctor.

normal.title: Normal Monocytes
normal.description: Monocyte counts are within expected limits.

basophils.name: Basophils
basophils.what_it_measures: Rare white blood cells that release histamine during inflammatory and allergic reactions.

high.title: High Basophils (Basophilia)
high.description: Basophil levels are above reference range.
high.recommendation: Discuss with a clinician if persistent across multiple reports.

low.title: Low Basophils
low.description: Basophils are near zero.
possible_associations: Normal finding (basophils normally constitute 0–1% of leukocytes)
low.recommendation: No clinical concern.

normal.title: Normal Basophils
normal.description: Basophils are within the expected physiological range.

platelet_count.name: Platelet Count
platelet_count.what_it_measures: Small cell fragments essential for normal blood clotting and vessel repair.

low.title: Low Platelets (Thrombocytopenia)
low.description: Platelet count is below the provided reference interval.
low.recommendation: Consult a healthcare professional promptly, especially if you notice easy bruising or bleeding.

high.title: High Platelets (Thrombocytosis)
high.description: Platelet count is above the reference interval.
high.recommendation: Review alongside inflammatory markers and iron status with your doctor.

normal.title: Normal Platelet Count
normal.description: Platelet count is within normal clotting parameters.

mpv.name: Mean Platelet Volume (MPV)
mpv.what_it_measures: Measures the average size of circulating platelets, reflecting bone marrow platelet production.

low.title: Low MPV
low.description: Platelets are smaller than average.
low.recommendation: Correlate with total platelet count with your physician.

high.title: High MPV
high.description: Platelets are larger and generally younger, indicating active bone marrow production.
high.recommendation: Review with your physician in context with overall platelet count.

normal.title: Normal MPV
normal.description: Platelet volume distribution is balanced.

total_bilirubin.name: Total Bilirubin
total_bilirubin.what_it_measures: Measures the total amount of yellow pigment formed from the normal breakdown of red blood cells.

high.title: Elevated Total Bilirubin (Hyperbilirubinemia)
high.description: Bilirubin concentration in blood is above the reference range.
high.recommendation: Discuss with a doctor to differentiate direct vs indirect fractions and review liver enzymes.

low.title: Low Total Bilirubin
low.description: Bilirubin is at the lower end of measurement.
possible_associations: No known pathological significance; often normal
low.recommendation: No action needed.

normal.title: Normal Total Bilirubin
normal.description: Bilirubin metabolism and liver clearance are within normal parameters.

direct_bilirubin.name: Direct (Conjugated) Bilirubin
direct_bilirubin.what_it_measures: The water-soluble form of bilirubin processed by the liver ready for bile excretion.

high.title: High Direct Bilirubin
high.description: Conjugated bilirubin is elevated, indicating impaired bile outflow.
high.recommendation: Prompt evaluation by a physician with liver enzymes and abdominal ultrasound if indicated.

normal.title: Normal Direct Bilirubin
normal.description: Biliary excretion of bilirubin is normal.

indirect_bilirubin.name: Indirect (Unconjugated) Bilirubin
indirect_bilirubin.what_it_measures: The lipid-soluble form of bilirubin bound to albumin prior to hepatic processing.

high.title: High Indirect Bilirubin
high.description: Unconjugated bilirubin is elevated in circulation.
high.recommendation: Discuss with your physician to correlate with complete blood counts and reticulocyte counts.

normal.title: Normal Indirect Bilirubin
normal.description: Unconjugated bilirubin levels are within healthy limits.

alt_sgpt.name: Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT / SGPT)
alt_sgpt.what_it_measures: An enzyme found predominantly in liver cells; leaks into bloodstream during hepatocellular stress.

high.title: Elevated ALT (Liver Enzyme)
high.description: ALT is elevated above the biological reference limit.
possible_associations: Alcohol consumption or acute liver inflammation
high.recommendation: Consult a healthcare provider to review medications, lifestyle factors, and schedule follow-up liver testing.

normal.title: Normal ALT
normal.description: Liver cellular integrity is normal.
possible_associations: Absence of active significant hepatic cell stress

ast_sgot.name: Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST / SGOT)
ast_sgot.what_it_measures: An enzyme present in liver cells, heart, and skeletal muscle tissue.

high.title: Elevated AST
high.description: AST is above the biological reference limit.
possible_associations: Intense muscle exercise or muscle injury
high.recommendation: Discuss with a physician in conjunction with ALT and recent strenuous physical activity.

normal.title: Normal AST
normal.description: AST levels are within expected limits.
possible_associations: Healthy liver and muscle enzyme activity

alkaline_phosphatase.name: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
alkaline_phosphatase.what_it_measures: An enzyme associated with the bile ducts in the liver and bone metabolism.

high.title: Elevated Alkaline Phosphatase
high.description: ALP is higher than expected.
possible_associations: High bone turnover (normal in adolescents and healing fractures)
Vitamin D deficiency or bone conditions
high.recommendation: A clinician can correlate with GGT to determine if elevation originates from liver or bone.

low.title: Low Alkaline Phosphatase
low.description: ALP is below the reference interval.
low.recommendation: Review nutritional intake with a healthcare professional.

normal.title: Normal Alkaline Phosphatase
normal.description: Biliary and bone enzyme activity is within normal ranges.

ggt.name: Gamma-Glutamyl Transferase (GGT)
ggt.what_it_measures: A sensitive biliary enzyme that helps distinguish liver from bone causes of elevated alkaline phosphatase.

high.title: Elevated GGT
high.description: GGT is above the biological reference limit.
high.recommendation: Review with your doctor to assess biliary health and hepatic medication tolerance.

normal.title: Normal GGT
normal.description: GGT is within normal limits.

total_protein.name: Total Protein
total_protein.what_it_measures: Measures the combined level of two main blood protein classes: albumin and globulin.

low.title: Low Total Protein
low.description: Serum protein is below reference range.
low.recommendation: Review with a clinician alongside albumin, urine protein, and dietary history.

high.title: High Total Protein
high.description: Serum protein is elevated above normal.
high.recommendation: Evaluate hydration and discuss with a physician if persistent.

normal.title: Normal Total Protein
normal.description: Circulating protein content is normal.
possible_associations: Adequate liver synthesis and protein retention

albumin.name: Albumin
albumin.what_it_measures: The main protein synthesized by the liver, maintaining oncotic blood pressure and transporting hormones and drugs.

low.title: Low Albumin (Hypoalbuminemia)
low.description: Serum albumin is reduced below expected limits.
low.recommendation: Promptly review with a healthcare provider to examine liver, kidney, and nutritional health.

high.title: High Albumin
high.description: Albumin is elevated.
high.recommendation: Increase oral fluid intake and retest if indicated.

normal.title: Normal Albumin
normal.description: Albumin levels are healthy.
possible_associations: Healthy hepatic synthetic function and renal retention

globulin.name: Globulin
globulin.what_it_measures: A family of proteins including antibodies (immunoglobulins), enzymes, and transport proteins.

low.title: Low Globulin
low.description: Globulin fraction is below expected values.
low.recommendation: Consult a physician to review immune status if recurrent infections are present.

high.title: High Globulin
high.description: Globulin fraction is elevated.
high.recommendation: Discuss with your doctor to investigate inflammatory or immune markers.

normal.title: Normal Globulin
normal.description: Globulin fraction is within normal limits.

albumin_globulin_ratio.name: Albumin/Globulin Ratio (A/G Ratio)
albumin_globulin_ratio.what_it_measures: The mathematical proportion of albumin relative to globulin proteins.

low.title: Low A/G Ratio
low.description: Albumin is lower or globulin is higher than standard proportion.
possible_associations: Kidney disease with selective albumin loss
low.recommendation: Review alongside individual albumin and globulin values with a doctor.

high.title: High A/G Ratio
high.description: Albumin is high relative to globulins.
high.recommendation: Generally of less clinical concern; correlate with immune history.

normal.title: Normal A/G Ratio
normal.description: Protein fractions are well balanced.

ldh.name: Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH)
ldh.what_it_measures: An intracellular enzyme present across nearly all body tissues; released when cells undergo damage or stress.

high.title: Elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH)
high.description: LDH is above the biological reference interval.
possible_associations: Tissue turnover, strenuous exercise, or muscle injury
high.recommendation: Discuss with a healthcare provider; often repeated with a fresh sample to exclude in vitro hemolysis.

normal.title: Normal LDH
normal.description: LDH is within normal limits.
possible_associations: Absence of significant non-specific tissue breakdown

serum_urea.name: Serum Urea
serum_urea.what_it_measures: Waste product produced by the liver from protein breakdown and cleared primarily by the kidneys.

high.title: Elevated Serum Urea
high.description: Urea concentration is above reference range.
possible_associations: High protein diet or gastrointestinal bleeding
high.recommendation: Ensure adequate hydration and discuss with a doctor in combination with creatinine.

low.title: Low Serum Urea
low.description: Urea is below expected range.
possible_associations: Low protein diet or severe malnutrition
low.recommendation: Review diet and liver health with your healthcare provider.

normal.title: Normal Serum Urea
normal.description: Urea production and renal elimination are balanced.
possible_associations: Adequate renal clearance of nitrogenous waste

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.what_it_measures: The amount of nitrogen in your blood that comes from the waste product urea.

high.title: Elevated Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
high.description: BUN is above normal reference limits.
high.recommendation: Review kidney parameters and fluid balance with your physician.

low.title: Low BUN
low.description: BUN is below normal limits.
low.recommendation: Correlate with general nutrition with a clinician.

normal.title: Normal BUN
normal.description: BUN is within normal limits.

serum_creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
serum_creatinine.what_it_measures: A breakdown byproduct of muscle creatine phosphate; the gold standard marker for glomerular filtration efficiency.

high.title: Elevated Creatinine
high.description: Creatinine level is above reference range.
possible_associations: High muscle mass, creatine supplements, or vigorous exercise
high.recommendation: Consult a healthcare provider promptly to evaluate eGFR, urine analysis, and medication safety.

low.title: Low Creatinine
low.description: Creatinine is lower than reference range.
possible_associations: Low muscle mass (sarcopenia or frail state)
low.recommendation: Correlate with muscle mass and nutritional status.

normal.title: Normal Creatinine
normal.description: Creatinine clearance and glomerular filtration are within expected parameters.
normal.recommendation: Maintain balanced hydration and kidney health.

egfr.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR)
egfr.what_it_measures: Calculated rate measuring how efficiently the microscopic filters in your kidneys (glomeruli) clean blood.

low.title: Reduced eGFR
low.description: eGFR is below expected threshold (e.g. < 90 or < 60 mL/min/1.73m2).
possible_associations: Acute kidney injury or temporary hypoperfusion
low.recommendation: Consult a physician or nephrologist for comprehensive kidney function evaluation.

normal.title: Normal eGFR (>= 90)
normal.description: Kidney filtering rate is within normal or optimal capacity.
normal.recommendation: No action needed; preserve with healthy lifestyle and hydration.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid
uric_acid.what_it_measures: Waste byproduct formed when the body breaks down purines found in food and bodily tissues.

high.title: Elevated Uric Acid (Hyperuricemia)
high.description: Uric acid is elevated above the biological reference interval.
possible_associations: High purine diet, alcohol, or metabolic syndrome
high.recommendation: Discuss with a doctor, especially if experiencing joint pain (notably in the big toe) or urinary symptoms.

low.title: Low Uric Acid
low.description: Uric acid is below reference limits.
low.recommendation: Generally benign unless taking urate-lowering medications.

normal.title: Normal Uric Acid
normal.description: Uric acid production and clearance are balanced.

sodium.name: Sodium (Na+)
sodium.what_it_measures: Major extracellular electrolyte regulating blood volume, fluid balance, and cellular membrane potentials.

low.title: Low Sodium (Hyponatremia)
low.description: Sodium concentration is below normal reference limits.
possible_associations: Excessive fluid intake or water retention
low.recommendation: Review fluid balance and medications promptly with a physician.

high.title: High Sodium (Hypernatremia)
high.description: Sodium concentration is elevated.
high.recommendation: Increase hydration and consult a doctor if experiencing significant thirst or weakness.

normal.title: Normal Sodium
normal.description: Fluid balance and extracellular electrolyte levels are optimal.

potassium.name: Potassium (K+)
potassium.what_it_measures: Critical intracellular electrolyte governing heart rhythm, nerve conduction, and muscle contraction.

low.title: Low Potassium (Hypokalemia)
low.description: Potassium is below reference limits.
low.recommendation: Consult a healthcare provider; significant hypokalemia requires prompt attention due to cardiac sensitivity.

high.title: High Potassium (Hyperkalemia)
high.description: Potassium is above the biological reference interval.
possible_associations: Laboratory artifact (fused or hemolyzed blood sample)
high.recommendation: Promptly consult a physician to review medications and confirm with an unhemolyzed repeat sample.

normal.title: Normal Potassium
normal.description: Cardiovascular and neuromodulatory potassium balance is normal.

chloride.name: Chloride (Cl-)
chloride.what_it_measures: Major extracellular anion working in tandem with sodium and potassium to maintain acid-base balance.

low.title: Low Chloride (Hypochloremia)
low.description: Chloride is below reference range.
low.recommendation: Review alongside sodium and bicarbonate with a physician.

high.title: High Chloride (Hyperchloremia)
high.description: Chloride is elevated.
high.recommendation: Discuss electrolyte and fluid balance with a clinician.

normal.title: Normal Chloride
normal.description: Acid-base and fluid balance are well maintained.

bicarbonate.name: Bicarbonate (CO2 Total)
bicarbonate.what_it_measures: An electrolyte measuring blood buffering capacity and systemic acid-base equilibrium.

low.title: Low Bicarbonate
low.description: Bicarbonate is below normal limits.
low.recommendation: Review with your physician in context with overall kidney function and metabolic panel.

high.title: High Bicarbonate
high.description: Bicarbonate is above normal limits.
high.recommendation: Discuss with a healthcare professional alongside respiratory health.

normal.title: Normal Bicarbonate
normal.description: Acid-base buffering capacity is healthy.

calcium.name: Serum Calcium
calcium.what_it_measures: Essential mineral required for bone mineralization, cardiac function, blood clotting, and nerve signaling.

low.title: Low Calcium (Hypocalcemia)
low.description: Calcium level is below reference interval.
low.recommendation: Check albumin and vitamin D levels with your healthcare provider.

high.title: High Calcium (Hypercalcemia)
high.description: Calcium is above reference interval.
possible_associations: Certain chronic granulomatous conditions or medications
high.recommendation: Consult a physician for PTH (parathyroid hormone) and vitamin D evaluation.

normal.title: Normal Calcium
normal.description: Serum calcium homeostasis is normal.
possible_associations: Normal bone and neuromodulatory mineral balance

phosphorus.name: Serum Phosphorus (Inorganic Phosphate)
phosphorus.what_it_measures: Mineral collaborating with calcium in bone structure and cellular ATP energy transfer.

low.title: Low Phosphorus (Hypophosphatemia)
low.description: Phosphorus is below the reference range.
low.recommendation: Review alongside calcium and vitamin D with a doctor.

high.title: High Phosphorus (Hyperphosphatemia)
high.description: Phosphorus is elevated.
high.recommendation: Discuss with your physician to evaluate kidney clearance and diet.

normal.title: Normal Phosphorus
normal.description: Phosphate balance is healthy.
possible_associations: Normal mineral and cellular energy metabolism

magnesium.name: Serum Magnesium
magnesium.what_it_measures: Essential cofactor for over 300 enzymatic processes including muscle contraction, nerve function, and blood pressure regulation.

low.title: Low Magnesium (Hypomagnesemia)
low.description: Magnesium is below reference interval.
possible_associations: Diuretic medication use or proton pump inhibitors (PPIs)
low.recommendation: Review medication list and dietary intake with a healthcare professional.

high.title: High Magnesium (Hypermagnesemia)
high.description: Magnesium is above reference interval.
possible_associations: Excessive use of magnesium-containing antacids or laxatives
high.recommendation: Discuss with a physician and review over-the-counter supplements and antacids.

normal.title: Normal Magnesium
normal.description: Serum magnesium is within optimal limits.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.what_it_measures: Total cholesterol measures the combined amount of all cholesterol fractions circulating in your blood, including LDL, HDL, and VLDL.

high.title: High Total Cholesterol
high.description: Total circulating cholesterol is above the desirable reference threshold.
high.recommendation: Discuss dietary habits and lifestyle with your doctor, and correlate with individual lipoprotein fractions.

low.title: Low Total Cholesterol
low.description: Total circulating cholesterol is below the expected reference interval.
low.recommendation: Consult your healthcare provider if associated with unexplained weight loss or malabsorption.

normal.title: Desirable Total Cholesterol
normal.description: Total cholesterol is within the standard reference target.
normal.recommendation: Maintain balanced nutrition and regular physical activity.

ldl.name: LDL Cholesterol
ldl.what_it_measures: LDL (low-density lipoprotein) transports cholesterol from the liver to peripheral tissues.

high.title: Elevated LDL Cholesterol
high.description: LDL cholesterol is above the desirable target threshold.
possible_associations: Diet high in saturated fats and trans fats
high.recommendation: Review nutrition, cardiovascular risk factors, and exercise with your physician.

low.title: Low LDL Cholesterol
low.description: LDL cholesterol is below typical laboratory thresholds.
low.recommendation: Usually favorable; correlate clinically with medications or nutritional intake.

normal.title: Optimal LDL Cholesterol
normal.description: LDL cholesterol is within the optimal target range.
normal.recommendation: Continue healthy dietary habits and regular exercise.

hdl.name: HDL Cholesterol
hdl.what_it_measures: HDL (high-density lipoprotein) transports cholesterol from peripheral tissues back to the liver for excretion.

low.title: Low HDL Cholesterol
low.description: HDL cholesterol is below the protective reference target.
low.recommendation: Consult your healthcare provider about aerobic exercise, healthy unsaturated fats, and lifestyle modifications.

high.title: High HDL Cholesterol
high.description: HDL cholesterol is above standard reference limits.
high.recommendation: Generally considered protective; evaluate in the complete lipid profile context.

normal.title: Normal HDL Cholesterol
normal.description: HDL cholesterol meets the recommended target.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.what_it_measures: Triglycerides are the primary storage form of fat in the body, reflecting circulating energy reserves.

high.title: High Triglycerides
high.description: Serum triglyceride levels exceed the standard reference threshold.
high.recommendation: Review fasting duration prior to testing, dietary sugars, alcohol intake, and exercise with your physician.

low.title: Low Triglycerides
low.description: Triglyceride levels are below expected norms.
low.recommendation: Consult your doctor if associated with low caloric intake or unintentional weight loss.

normal.title: Normal Triglycerides
normal.description: Triglyceride levels are within the normal reference interval.
possible_associations: Balanced caloric intake and energy metabolism
normal.recommendation: Maintain balanced lifestyle and nutritional habits.

vldl.name: VLDL Cholesterol
vldl.what_it_measures: VLDL (very low-density lipoprotein) is produced by the liver to deliver triglycerides to body tissues.

high.title: Elevated VLDL Cholesterol
high.description: VLDL cholesterol is elevated above the reference threshold.
high.recommendation: Discuss metabolic and triglyceride health with your healthcare provider.

normal.title: Normal VLDL Cholesterol
normal.description: VLDL cholesterol is within standard limits.
possible_associations: Normal hepatic triglyceride packaging and clearance

non_hdl.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol
non_hdl.what_it_measures: Non-HDL cholesterol represents total cholesterol minus HDL, capturing all atherogenic lipoproteins.

high.title: Elevated Non-HDL Cholesterol
high.description: Non-HDL cholesterol is above standard reference targets.
possible_associations: Combined elevations in LDL and VLDL
high.recommendation: Discuss comprehensive lipid management with your physician.

normal.title: Optimal Non-HDL Cholesterol
normal.description: Non-HDL cholesterol is within desirable boundaries.

cholesterol_hdl_ratio.name: Cholesterol / HDL Ratio
cholesterol_hdl_ratio.what_it_measures: Calculated ratio of total cholesterol to protective HDL cholesterol.

high.title: Elevated TC / HDL Ratio
high.description: The ratio of total cholesterol relative to HDL is above the target reference limit.
possible_associations: Higher total cholesterol relative to HDL
high.recommendation: Review with your physician alongside lifestyle factors and individual lipid parameters.

normal.title: Normal TC / HDL Ratio
normal.description: The ratio between total cholesterol and HDL is within standard limits.
possible_associations: Balanced ratio of circulating cholesterol to HDL
normal.recommendation: Maintain regular activity and a balanced diet.

ldl_hdl_ratio.name: LDL / HDL Ratio
ldl_hdl_ratio.what_it_measures: Calculated ratio comparing atherogenic LDL cholesterol to protective HDL cholesterol.

high.title: Elevated LDL / HDL Ratio
high.description: The proportion of LDL relative to HDL is higher than the recommended reference target.
high.recommendation: Discuss lipid balance and dietary optimization with your physician.

normal.title: Normal LDL / HDL Ratio
normal.description: The LDL to HDL proportion is within desirable limits.
possible_associations: Healthy balance between atherogenic and protective lipoproteins

apolipoprotein_a1.name: Apolipoprotein A1 (ApoA1)
apolipoprotein_a1.what_it_measures: Apolipoprotein A1 is the principal protein component of HDL particles, facilitating reverse cholesterol transport.

low.title: Low Apolipoprotein A1
low.description: ApoA1 levels are below the reference interval.
low.recommendation: Review with your healthcare provider alongside HDL and lifestyle habits.

high.title: Elevated Apolipoprotein A1
high.description: ApoA1 levels are above the expected interval.
high.recommendation: Usually considered protective; correlate with overall lipid profile.

normal.title: Normal Apolipoprotein A1
normal.description: ApoA1 concentration is within expected reference bounds.

apolipoprotein_b.name: Apolipoprotein B (ApoB)
apolipoprotein_b.what_it_measures: Apolipoprotein B is the primary structural protein on atherogenic lipoproteins, indicating total particle count.

high.title: Elevated Apolipoprotein B
high.description: ApoB levels are above the reference limit.
possible_associations: Increased number of circulating atherogenic particles (LDL, VLDL)
high.recommendation: Review particle numbers and cardiovascular risk factors with your healthcare provider.

low.title: Low Apolipoprotein B
low.description: ApoB levels are below standard reference thresholds.
low.recommendation: Correlate with medications and nutritional history.

normal.title: Normal Apolipoprotein B
normal.description: ApoB levels are within the expected target interval.

apob_apoa1_ratio.name: Apo B / Apo A1 Ratio
apob_apoa1_ratio.what_it_measures: Ratio evaluating the balance between atherogenic (ApoB) and protective (ApoA1) lipoprotein particles.

high.title: Elevated Apo B / Apo A1 Ratio
high.description: The balance favors atherogenic particles relative to protective HDL particles.
possible_associations: Higher ApoB particle density relative to ApoA1
high.recommendation: Review with your clinician in the context of your broader lipid profile.

normal.title: Normal Apo B / Apo A1 Ratio
normal.description: The balance between atherogenic and anti-atherogenic particles is within standard limits.
normal.recommendation: Continue healthy diet and physical activity.
